state.question: Tell me about this building using the record: distinguish its soft launch, first classes and certification dates.
state.answer: This is the Kendeda Building for Innovative Sustainable Design. According to the record, it reached substantial completion and had its soft launch in fall 2019. The first classes in the building began in January 2020. It later achieved Living Building Challenge certification in March 2021.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://livingbuilding.gatech.edu/about): The Kendeda Building for Innovative Sustainable Design reached substantial completion and soft launch in fall 2019. Classes began in January 2020; Living Building Challenge certification followed in March 2021. Lord Aeck Sargent and The Miller Hull Partnership led architecture; Skanska USA built it.
